title: Player Spell authoring schema candidate v1 - structural validation
description: CANDIDATE authoring schema (docs/architecture/OTERYN_SPELL_AUTHORING_SCHEMA_V1.md). Not a WorldProject/v2 contract or runtime activation; semantic rules live in validate_spell.py.

vocation.description: S8: explicit base or promoted vocation key; a promoted vocation is never implied by its base vocation. none: source vocation id 0 (unvocational starter characters); no promoted vocation is inferred.

groupKey.description: Cooldown group key, lowercase without spaces (attack, healing, support, focus, greatbeams, ...).

decimal.description: S5: decimal literal, read as the nearest IEEE-754 double (the source literal).

expression.description: S5: formula expression over declared inputs, evaluated in IEEE-754 double in authored operation order.

oneOf.description: S5: the world level curve of TibiaWiki Formulae: S = floor((sqrt(2L + 2025) + 5) / 10), B = floor((L + 1000) / S) + 50S - 450 (Crystal calculateBaseDamageHealing).

inputs.description: level_magic: level, magic_level, base_power and the caster's shielding_skill (knight healing); skill: level, attack_skill, attack_value, attack_factor, base_power, shielding_skill, shield_defense. The engine fills attack_* from the wielded weapon (a world combat rule) and shield_defense from the wielded shield (only a needs_shield Spell reads it; S27 D.4).

formula.description: S5: magnitude range of a damage or heal Effect cast by a player. Each bound is evaluated, truncated toward zero and then drawn by the world damage distribution.

item.description: S2: the rune Item (Item authority stays with the Item catalogue).

blocking.description: Canary/Crystal rune:isBlocking(blockingSolid, blockingCreature): the target tile may not hold a solid item / a creature; engine default false, false.

effect_asset_binding.description: S18: the magic effect shown on the caster after a successful conjure (a rune always shows magic_red).

conjure.description: S2: removes one reagent (when present) and creates count result items.

parameters.description: Data parameters of the shared behaviour (S7).

message_template.const: The monster {location}. Be prepared to find a creature of difficulty level "{difficulty}".

warning_template.const: This monster will stay fiendish for less than {minutes} minutes and {seconds} seconds.

warning_under_minute_template.const: This monster will stay fiendish for less than {seconds} seconds.

no_target_message.const: At the moment there is no fiend with special loot roaming this world.

execution.description: Exactly one execution: an Ability (plain or random combat), a conjure, or a native behaviour.

words.description: Spoken words, lowercase; required for instant spells.

reference_spell_id.description: Client spell id (Canary/Crystal spell:id, wiki spellid).

library_text.description: S19: the official spell library text (Cyclopedia Magical Archive, tibia.com library), verbatim; optional.

level.description: Required character level; 0 = none (monk starter spells).

learning_required.description: S10/S16: false since patch 15.22 (spells unlock at their level); learned spells are Character state.

wheel_unlock.description: S6/S16: a Wheel of Destiny revelation spell; not castable until a Wheel owner exists (fails closed).

vocation_display_flags.description: Source vocation registrar description flags, distinct from cast eligibility. Preserves source argument order; candidate data support does not establish native consumption.

cooldown_ms.description: Source cooldown in milliseconds. Zero means no registrar cooldown; custom callbacks may enforce separate reuse. Candidate schema support does not establish native zero-cooldown consumption.

harmony_role.description: S26: the monk Harmony role (Canary monkSpellType): a builder adds Harmony, a spender consumes it. Only monk vocations may carry this role; casting requires the runtime to supply the owning Harmony state.

groups.description: S9: primary group first, then an optional secondary group; group keys differ.

block_walls.description: The cast needs a clear line of sight (Canary/Crystal blockWalls = checkLineOfSight, engine default true).

aim_at_target.description: S20: a direction spell the player may set to turn towards the attacked creature before casting (client "Aim at Target"; BR aimattarget).

cast_at_position.description: Source needPosition/optionalTarget flag. Retained independently of needs_target; owning engine selects the variant route and an executor must reproduce its precedence.

allowed_targets.description: S27 D.3 and B.5: who a single-target cast may be aimed at; absent means any. self_or_own_summons: the caster or a creature the caster summoned or convinced (healing runes). not_self: any creature but the caster (Nature's Embrace); needs a target and no self target. allow_on_self false means not_self.

needs_shield.description: S27 D.4: the caster must wield a shield in the left or right hand ("You need to equip a shield to cast this spell."); absent means false.

base_power.description: Reference base power (wiki basepower, Crystal basePower); a formula input, not a damage value.

harmony_cost.description: Crystal spell:harmony: when true, successful postCastSpell resets all player Harmony to zero. Distinct from Canary builder/spender harmony_role; no native consumption claimed.

elemental_cast_type.description: Canary spell:element accepted CombatType; used for createElementalSpellCastSnapshot and commit on successful cast. This is source registrar element, not replacement for every Effect damage type; no native consumption claimed.

stance_slot.description: Canary spell:stance accepted instant spell stance slot. Successful cast toggles stance by spell id; no native consumption claimed.

reference_rune_item_id.description: Source numeric runeId retained independently of a qualified ItemRef. Does not supply Item authority, provider revision or native activation.

source_carrier_symbol.description: Disabled source fixture symbolic constructor capture. This is not an executable carrier and is not accepted on a full gameplay Spell.

sourceProjection.description: Partial source-only header projection. Field presence follows explicit registrar facts; no defaults, identity, execution or runtime activation are inferred. Validity here does not make a full executable Spell.

sourceSoundReference.description: Source symbol reference only, qualified against owning C++ SoundEffect_t and actual Lua namespace registration. knownbound means source Lua binding exists, not that a native cue/asset exists. unbound has no numeric value. Never allocates a native cue.
